author: SGMC
body:
Hey, this is just a quick post about a new walls map I'm making; it's designed to be a bit harder than some other maps in the sense that there are quite a few ways too die before the walls drop, starvation being the main one. The basic concept is that you are either an Archaeologist, Traveler, Runaway, or Explorer (the four team names) who somehow managed to get themselves stranded in the middle of a desert. With little supplies, it's your goal to survive against the elements and bloodthirsty other players. 

Currently, the terrain is just sandy hills, and the only structure is a small, destroyed sandstone temple. Clearly, more things are needed... if you have any ideas make sure to comment! I'm honestly at a bit of a dead end as for what to add next .-.
